title: results-2 current remaining contract review
reviewMethod: Manual SFC/helper/child-forwarding recheck of each original missing candidate and semantics row. Source token presence is only an anchor; disposition reflects the runtime path reviewed. No tests/build executed.
verificationBoundary: Historical working-tree assessment snapshot plus explicit stale boundaries. `sourceSha256`/`reviewedSourceSha256` are preserved assessment hashes; rows listed stale-after-review are unverified even when the present file exists. Their current SHA is separate and does not validate the old classification. API/demo/test/visual sync was not checked.

approvedDecisions.decision: Stepper mandatory defaults to force; explicit false remains honored.
List and Treeview selectable default false; Treeview single-leaf default, openOnClick inferred from selectable && !activatable; List selected and Treeview activated use arrays.
Overlay, Menu and Dialog eager default false; independent Overlay scrollStrategy none; Overlay captureFocus/retainFocus false and explicit retainFocus enables modal behavior.
Temporary NavigationDrawer closes on route changes by default; disableRouteWatcher opts out.
UAH keeps its local tokens and visual styles; style-only differences are recorded as local style, not missing runtime APIs.
